description: Provenance for real application UI screenshots used by the demo showcase. Crops remove test harness navigation or unused surrounding space; no application UI was drawn or replaced. All visible people, phone numbers, tax data and amounts originate from disposable synthetic fixtures. Dealer is the native pilot login screen; Companion image shows Desktop pairing settings, not a connected phone.
